data: BEGINNING OF CONVERSATION: USER: I need to book a flight from Omaha to Dallas for January 15. ASSISTANT:
You can book a flight from Omaha to Dallas on January 15 through a variety of airlines. You can use a flight search engine to find the best option for your needs.

BEGINNING OF CONVERSATION: USER: I cook for my husband but he does not seem to appreciate it. He usually makes fun of the food I cook but he would eat the entire dish. ASSISTANT:

It is understandable that your husband may not show his appreciation in words. It is possible that he is feeling uncomfortable and may not know how to express his feelings. It would be helpful to talk to him about how his actions make you feel and express your appreciation for his efforts.
